Kennon Wooten, who practices law in Austin, Texas, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2019 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at The University of Texas School of Law. She graduated in 2004. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 2004.
